about_the_game:
**About this game**

"Ouch! So many beauties!" - This is not just a game, it is an interactive video game with real emotions, and a love simulation journey with ups and downs. Here is a first-person perspective of love that you can't experience elsewhere. Find your own story in passion and warmth.

In the game, you will meet a variety of female characters, who are innocent, willful, sexy, charming, or noble and cool. But more importantly, these characters have deep personalities and stories, and their hearts are full of longing for love and expectations for you. As the plot develops, they will also show real and complex psychological and emotional reactions, adding more explorability and depth to the game.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some explicit or pornographic content, as well as sensitive content such as alcohol abuse, which may not be suitable for all age groups.
